caption: Pyramid of Cestius, Rome
composition: White marble Egyptian-style pyramid beside the Aurelian Walls · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the street corner at midday, the Pyramid of Cestius rising sheer at the center of the frame. Its white marble faces climb to the apex against a pale blue sky, while the brick mass of the Aurelian Walls runs behind it to the left and right. The modelled 23 September 2026, 12:30 sun bleaches the marble almost white, and the small gatehouse at the pyramid's base anchors the unlikely ancient monument to the modern road.
